elements.plain_summary: The declarations page identifies the named insured and insured location, states the policy period (2026-01-01 to 2027-01-01), and lists the coverage limits, deductible, and total premium that apply to this policy.
elements.source_text: Named insured, insured location, policy period 2026-01-01 to 2027-01-01, coverage limits, and total premium.

elements.plain_summary: Coverage A - Dwelling insures the house itself against direct physical loss, up to the $350,000 limit shown on the declarations and after the $1,000 deductible, subject to the Section I exclusions.
elements.source_text: We insure the dwelling on the residence premises against risk of direct physical loss, subject to the exclusions in Section I.

elements.plain_summary: Coverage C - Personal Property covers belongings owned or used by an insured, generally up to 50% of the Coverage A limit ($175,000), with special sub-limits for categories such as jewelry and electronics.
elements.source_text: We cover personal property owned or used by an insured, generally up to 50% of the Coverage A limit, subject to special limits for certain categories.

elements.plain_summary: Coverage D - Loss of Use pays additional living expenses, up to $70,000, while the home is not fit to live in because of a covered loss; it references endorsement END-99, which was not provided.
elements.source_text: We cover the additional living expenses incurred while the residence premises is not fit to live in due to a covered loss.

elements.plain_summary: Section I - Exclusions lists perils the form does not insure, including flood, surface water, earth movement, and neglect; losses from these perils fall outside Section I coverage.
elements.source_text: We do not insure for loss caused by flood, surface water, earth movement, or neglect, whether or not any other cause contributes to the loss.

elements.plain_summary: The Duties After Loss condition sets out what an insured must do after a loss - give prompt notice, protect the property from further damage, prepare an inventory, and cooperate with the investigation.
elements.source_text: After a loss the insured must give prompt notice, protect the property from further damage, prepare an inventory, and cooperate in the investigation.

elements.plain_summary: The policy defines actual cash value as the replacement cost of property reduced by depreciation for its age and condition.
elements.source_text: Actual cash value means the cost to replace property reduced by depreciation for age and condition.

elements.plain_summary: Endorsement HO 04 90 adds limited water-backup coverage, up to the sub-limit shown on the declarations, for loss caused by water backing up through sewers or drains.
elements.source_text: This endorsement adds limited coverage, up to the sub-limit shown on the declarations, for direct loss caused by water that backs up through sewers or drains.

elements.plain_summary: The premium summary shows a total annual premium of $1,842.00, allocated across the Section I property coverages, Section II liability, and the endorsements.
elements.source_text: Total annual premium of 1,842.00 allocated across Section I coverages, Section II liability, and endorsements.

narrative: This explains policy ****7788, form HO-3 (07/2021), in force from 2026-01-01 to 2027-01-01. The declarations page lists the named insured, the insured location, the coverage limits, the $1,000 deductible, and the total premium. Section I provides dwelling coverage (Coverage A, $350,000), personal property coverage (Coverage C, $175,000), and loss-of-use coverage (Coverage D, $70,000), each subject to the deductible and the Section I exclusions. Section I - Exclusions lists perils the form does not insure, such as flood, surface water, and earth movement. The Duties After Loss condition describes the steps an insured takes after a loss. One referenced endorsement (END-99) was not included in the document, so its terms could not be explained. Whether any particular situation results in a payment depends on the exact policy language and the facts of the loss; contact the insurer or agent to confirm.
